verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single marketing line stating Fireflies 'identifies different speakers in meetings and audio files,' which confirms diarization but gives no detail on how real names (vs. generic Speaker 1/2 labels) are matched to speakers, e.g., via calendar invitee or voice-profile matching. Missing for 10: documentation of real-name attribution mechanism, accuracy benchmarks, and independent/hands-on corroboration of correct speaker labeling.
